question: What is the name of the scheme launched by the Government of India for the financial inclusion of path or street vendors, whose anniversary was celebrated from July 9 to July 31, 2022?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**PM SVANidhi Scheme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **PM SVANidhi Scheme (Prime Minister Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi) **was launched by the Government of India to facilitate affordable **working capital loans to street vendors.**
 
• It was introduced in June 2020 as part of the relief measures during the COVID-19 pandemic, aiming to support the livelihood activities of street vendors who were adversely affected by the **lockdown**.
 
• Under this scheme, vendors can avail of a working capital loan of up to** INR 10,000 (approx USD 137)** with minimal documentation.
 
• The scheme also incentivizes regular loan repayment with interest subsidies and provides the vendors with digital transaction rewards.
 
• It aims to benefit over **50 lakh (5 million) street vendors across India**, covering both urban and rural areas.
 
• The scheme's first anniversary was celebrated from** July 9 to July 31, 2022**, recognizing its impact and the progress made in achieving its goals.
